subject: FinoSys DPA request & signature routing — counter needed
thread_summary: Customer legal sent DPA with redlines. Internal legal proposed counters and two exceptions; sales routed counter-offer and DocuSign link. Customer accepted and returned signed DPA. Conversation documents signature routing and required billing contact for final paperwork.
messages:
From: Sarah Jansen <sarah.jansen@finosys.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@finosys.com
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: FinoSys DPA + SCCs (initial request)

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is keen to move to a PO. Legal has one request before we issue the PO: please review the attached DPA (we've added our redlines) and confirm whether Redwood can accept the EU Standard Contractual Clauses and the HIPAA BAA language we flagged.

High-level asks:
- Accept SCCs (we can provide executed annex if needed)
- Confirm retention and deletion commitments (we flag 7-year retention in §6)
- Confirm liability cap is stated as mutual and not unilateral

Can you confirm who at Redwood will review? We'd like to get this wrapped this week if possible — PO target is 04/20.

Attachment: FinoSys_DPA_v1_redlines.pdf (PDF, 178 KB)

Thanks,
Sarah Jansen
Senior Counsel, FinoSys Inc.
sarah.jansen@finosys.com | +1-415-555-0123

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jansen <sarah.jansen@finosys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinoSys DPA + SCCs (initial request)

Hi Sarah — thanks for sending and for the timeline. Looping in Marissa (Legal) and Karthik (Security) so they can review the redlines and confirm SCC/BAA compatibility.

Marissa / Karthik: can you review the attached and advise on two things: 1) whether the SCC template FinoSys proposes is compatible with our hosting model, and 2) whether the HIPAA/BAA language requires a separate addendum or can be folded into our standard DPA. If you can share a recommended counter by Monday EOD, I’ll send to FinoSys with DocuSign routing info.

Im also noting the requested 7-year retention — that’s longer than our standard 3-year default; flagging for policy decision.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com | +1-628-555-0199

On Sat, Apr 11, 2026 at 09:18 AM Sarah Jansen <sarah.jansen@finosys.com> wrote:
> (attached)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: legal_ops@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: FinoSys DPA + SCCs (initial request)

Neha — reviewed the FinoSys redlines and prepared counters. Key points below; see attached counters for full redline (Redwood_DPA_Counters_20260412.docx).

Summary of our positions:
- SCCs: we can sign the EU SCCs but need to append a short Annex that maps subprocessors and regions. Karthik confirms no EEA-only processing restrictions that block SCCs.
- HIPAA / BAA: we can accept a BAA but prefer a standalone addendum. This avoids scope creep in the DPA and aligns with our SOC 2 controls. Were providing BAA language as an addendum option.
- Retention: we cannot commit to 7 years by default. We propose a 3-year standard with ability to extend by written request tied to a specific purpose.
- Liability cap: we can agree to a mutual cap. Requested change: remove unilateral higher cap, set standard mutual cap aligned with the underlying MSA (3x fees, not exceeding $5M).

Two contract exceptions Im escalating for leadership sign-off (please advise):
1) Data deletion timeline for archival/backups: FinoSys request of 30 days for deletion after termination conflicts with our backup retention and legal hold processes. Proposed 90 days with a dedicated delete job and certification.
2) Security audit frequency: FinoSys requested quarterly SOC-type evidence delivery. We provide SOC 2 annual and targeted audits; quarterly custom audits would be billable.

Next steps I recommend: Neha sends our counters and DocuSign routing (we can route to CEO or GC depending on FinoSys signers). If FinoSys signs counters, well require a billing contact for the PO.

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_Counters_20260412.docx (DOCX, 95 KB)

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1-415-555-0207

Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinoSys DPA + SCCs (initial request)

Hi Sarah — thanks for patience. Attached are Redwood's counters. High-level: we can accept SCCs with a short Annex, prefer a standalone BAA addendum, propose 3-year default retention, and a mutual liability cap aligned with our MSA. Marissa called out two items that require leadership sign-off (backup deletion timeline and quarterly audit requests) — weve proposed language that should be acceptable to most customers.

To keep momentum toward your PO target, Im proposing the following immediate steps:
1) Review our counters (attached) and confirm signers at FinoSys (legal + authorized signee).
2) If acceptable, we will prepare DocuSign envelope and route to the signers you confirm. Link will be provided via DocuSign; signers will need to authenticate.
3) Please confirm billing contact (name + email) to appear on the PO and invoice.

DocuSign draft (will be live once you confirm signers): https://app.docusign.com/secure/12345abcdef

Attachment: Redwood_DPA_Counters_20260412.docx (DOCX, 95 KB)

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com | +1-628-555-0199

Neha — thanks, appreciate the quick turnaround. We reviewed Redwood's counters and are prepared to accept the proposed language with the standalone BAA addendum. Two notes:
- We can accept 3-year retention provided there is a documented process for extension tied to a specific legal requirement.
- On deletion timing: 90 days for backup deletion is acceptable.

I have routed the DocuSign envelope to our authorized signee (name: Michael Torres, title: VP Procurement). I signed on behalf of FinoSys via the DocuSign link; you should see a signed copy attached. Please confirm receipt and next steps for invoicing.
